title: Optimal Clustering of Multi-layer Networks under Mixture Block Models
abstract: arXiv:2311.15598v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study clustering for multi-layer networks, where each observation is an undirected network measured on the same set of vertices. Under the mixture multi-layer stochastic block model (MMSBM), each network is generated from one of two stochastic block models, and the goal is to recover the latent network labels. We establish the minimax optimal network clustering error rate, which takes an exponential form and is characterized by the Chernoff information between the edge probability distributions of the component networks. We propose a novel two-stage estimator that combines tensor-based initialization, node and sample splitting, and a likelihood-based refinement. The refinement step exploits estimated node communities and achieves the minimax rate with high probability under extreme network sparsity. translated_title: 混合块模型下多层网络的最优聚类
translated_abstract: 我们研究多层网络的聚类问题，其中每个观测值都是在同一组顶点上测量的无向网络。在混合多层随机块模型（MMSBM）下，每个网络由两个随机块模型之一生成，目标是恢复潜在的网络标签。我们建立了极小极大最优的网络聚类错误率，该错误率呈指数形式，并由各分量网络边概率分布之间的Chernoff信息刻画。我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段估计器，它结合了基于张量的初始化、节点与样本分割以及基于似然的精化方法。该精化步骤利用估计得到的节点社区结构，在极端网络稀疏性的条件下也能以高概率达到极小极大最优率。我们进一步通过混合多层泊松块模型，将似然精化框架扩展到计数加权网络。
tldr: 本文在混合多层随机块模型下建立了由Chernoff信息刻画的极小极大最优网络聚类错误率，并提出了一种结合张量初始化与似然精化的两阶段估计器，在极端稀疏条件下仍能达到该最优率，且可扩展至计数加权网络。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the minimax optimal network clustering error rate under the mixture multi-layer stochastic block model, characterized by the Chernoff information, and proposes a novel two-stage estimator combining tensor initialization and likelihood-based refinement that achieves this optimal rate even under extreme sparsity, with extensions to count-weighted networks.
